new_jobs.jd: Based at Global Headquarters, this role is responsible for leading the global Control Tower function to strengthen operational support, drive cross-regional alignment, and ensure execution excellence throughout the network. The position will establish standardized operating practices, provide governance and performance oversight, facilitate collaboration among regional operations teams, and ensure timely resolution of operational issues and enhance customer satisfaction, and drive operational excellence on a global scale. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** This role plays a critical role in supporting the company's VIP semiconductor customers by ensuring operational stability, executive-level visibility, and consistent service delivery across the global network. **1. Global Control Tower Alignment:** * Manage the Control Tower team to provide centralized operational oversight for assigned global semiconductor accounts. * Establish and maintain standardized operating procedures, governance processes, and service standards across all participating stations. **2. Operational Coordination & Execution** * Act as the primary operational escalation point for overseas stations and internal stakeholders. * Ensure seamless shipment execution, timely milestone management, and proactive handling of service exceptions. * Coordinate cross-functional teams to resolve operational issues and minimize supply chain disruptions. * Attend conference calls outside regular office hours, including occasional late-night meetings with overseas as required. * Travel domestically and internationally as required for customer, operational, and business needs. **3. Performance Management & Continuous Improvement** * Monitor operational KPIs and service performance across global locations. * Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring service issues. * Drive operational excellence initiatives to improve service quality, productivity, visibility, and customer satisfaction. **4. Customer & Stakeholder Management** * Support Global Account Managers in customer reviews, business updates, and strategic operational discussions. * Build strong working relationships with customers, regional operations teams, and internal stakeholders. * Provide timely updates on critical operational matters, potential risks, and mitigation actions. **5. Account Implementation & Business Support** * Support customer onboarding, operational implementation, and SOP deployment for new business opportunities. * Ensure operational readiness and alignment among all participating stations during account transitions and business expansions. **6. Reporting & Analytics** * Analyze operational data and performance trends to identify improvement opportunities. * Prepare and support Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR), management reports, and customer presentations. * Utilize data analytics and AI-enabled tools to enhance reporting effectiveness and operational insights. **ESSENTIAL JOB QUALIFICATIONS** **Education/Technical Skills** * Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Engineering, or related disciplines. * Strong command of both written and spoken English and Chinese, with effective communication skills for collaboration across Asia-Pacific, Americas, and Europe offices * Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook); Good working knowledge of AI applications and data analytics tools. * Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills. **Knowledge/ Work Experience** * Minimum 8 years of experience in freight forwarding key account management. * At least 3 years of leadership or supervisory experience preferred. * Experience managing multinational or strategic key accounts, preferably within the semiconductor, technology, or high-tech manufacturing sectors. * Proven experience coordinating operations across multiple countries and regions. * Familiarity with KPI management, operational governance, continuous improvement, and customer escalation management. **Key Behavioral Competencies** * Strong logical thinking and problem-solving ability. * Detail-oriented and precise, with a strong mindset for customer service and operation improvement. * Excellent time management skills; able to handle multiple tasks efficiently. * A strong team player with effective cross-functional collaboration skills, while also capable of working independently. * Proactive, accountable, and results oriented.

new_jobs.title: Logistics Manager
new_jobs.jd: **Who We Are** At Framework, we believe the time has come for products that are designed to last. Founded in San Francisco in 2020, our mission is to remake Consumer Electronics to respect people and the planet. We've started with two award-winning products, the Framework Laptop 13 and 16. Our laptops are thin, light, high-performance notebooks that can be upgraded, customized, and repaired in ways that no other notebook can. Alongside this, we've launched the Framework Marketplace to enable an ecosystem of parts and modules. In 2026, we introduced Framework Laptop 13 Pro, a ground-up redesign built for power users and developers, bringing a massive leap in battery life, a new CNC aluminum chassis, and our first Ubuntu Certified system, all while remaining repairable, upgradeable, and entirely yours. We've seen a fantastic reception to Framework Laptop 13 Pro, with MKBHD calling it our “best build yet," Linus Tech Tips declaring "The Framework Pro 13 is peak laptop," and Gizmodo naming it "The Best Modular Laptop Ever Made." That builds on years of recognition from outlets like Ars Technica and multiple Wirecutter reviews (including a recommendation among the best Windows Ultrabooks of 2024), along with making TIME's Best Inventions lists in 2021 and 2023. We're incredibly proud to be recognized as #5 on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2026, proof of our growth since first appearing on the list at #35 on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies of 2022. We come from successful consumer electronics startups including the founding team of Oculus, and have closed multiple rounds of funding to fuel our roadmap. Even better (and maybe unusually for an early stage startup), we're in a financially healthy position going forward off of our product revenue. We care deeply about building a diverse and inclusive team, and we hope you do too! ****The Position**** We are looking for a Logistics Manager who is excited to take on the challenges that come with delivering innovative and modular products to customers worldwide, while upholding our commitment to respect both people and our planet. In this role, you will drive and execute the department’s high level logistics fulfillment strategy, managing global fulfillment efforts, developing processes that support our internal team and our customers as we scale and expand into new regions, and owning all cross-functional engagement with internal teams. You will also cultivate key vendor partnerships, representing the logistics teams in internal projects, spearheading stock availability for preorder fulfillment, and enhancing operational performance through deep internal integrations and strategic alliances. As a member of the Logistics Team, you will handle some of the critical “last touch” movements before our products reach our customers’ hands, and will have a high level of influence on the consumer experience as well as our internal logistics practices and initiatives going forward. This is a full-time hybrid position in Taiwan, with 10% travel required (when travel is reasonable) and a preference for candidates residing in Northern Taiwan (e.g. Taipei, Taoyuan, and Hsinchu). We have an office in XinYi Dist that you can work from. **What You'll Do** * Departmental Strategy & Goals - Lead the execution of logistics department strategy and operational goals, ensuring alignment with high-level business objectives. * Vendor & Relationship Management - Manage critical relationships with EU, North American, and in-country service providers (3PLs, carriers, freight providers) including performance reviews (QBRs/KPIs), onboarding, and RFQ oversight. * Cross-Functional Leadership - Act as the primary logistics representative and SME for internal partners (Engineering, Quality, CX, B2B, Finance) on sensitive shipments, special projects, and strategic integrations. * Operational Efficiency - Drive systemic solutions for recurring shipping issues and spearhead initiatives to improve fulfillment performance and minimize operational redundancies. * Fulfillment & Pre-order Management - Own end-to-end pre-order management and supervise daily fulfillment activities for global 3PLs to ensure strict contractual SLA adherence. * Compliance & Trade SME - Serve as the Subject Matter Expert for customs and trade compliance, managing all shipments and ensuring VAT/EORI/ART23 adherence for EU logistics. * Inventory & Asset Control - Lead mid-year and year-end inventory reconciliations and manage strategic SKU conversion, kitting, and repack projects to optimize costs. * Financial Oversight - Audit and approve all vendor invoices for 3PLs and carriers, while monitoring cost performance and developing leadership dashboards. * Escalation Management - Act as the primary in-country escalation point for the logistics team, providing support for fulfillment, shipping, and complex compliance hurdles. * Systems & IT Integration - Provide strategic support for new IT integrations and system setups to enhance data sharing and operational visibility with vendor partners. **What You Need** * Excellent communication skills, with fluency in English * Experience in E-commerce 3PL based fulfillment and logistics * 5+ years of experience in global shipping including trade compliance * 3+ years of experience managing 3PL & small parcel vendor relationships in Asia * 3+ years of experience in consumer electronics or similar regulated industries * Working knowledge of Google Workspace, relational databases and ERP systems (e.g. SAP or Netsuite) * Proven understanding of supply chain processes (e.g. inventory planning, procurement, multi-region fulfillment) * Experience in data-driven decision making and reporting **What's Nice To Have** * Customs brokerage license * Familiarity with OEM/ODM manufacturing. * FedEx global shipping and consolidation (IPD) experience * Global logistics experience with emphasis on trade compliance * Strong analytical mind with enthusiasm for problem-solving **What You'll Love** * Competitive salary, equity, and health benefits * Paid company holidays plus 20 PTO days per year * Paid Parental Leave * Annual Health Checks * Flexible work hours and locations, including every other Monday off! * The chance to work at a startup that is making a positive social and environmental impact. ****Equal Opportunity**** **We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let us know by reaching out to accommodations@frame.work.** **Additional Notes** Please be aware that we only post jobs directly on our career site, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Monster, Talent.com, MyJobHelper, Adzuna, Jora, and Jooble. We do not use Indeed. For the safest experience, please apply directly on our career site. We also follow a rigorous hiring process, meaning we do not extend offers without multiple rounds of live interviews. Most importantly, we do not issue checks to candidates and will never ask for personal financial information, such as bank details or credit card numbers, during the interview and offer process. We manage onboarding through our HRIS platform and provide all necessary equipment directly to our employees. All official communications during the interview process only come from @ats.rippling.com and @frame.work. If you receive a suspicious message, email, or job offer, please do not click on any links and report this incident to us at hiring-team@frame.work.

new_jobs.title: Operation Manager
new_jobs.jd: **About Hytech** Hytech is a leading management consulting firm headquartered in Australia and Singapore, specializing in digital transformation for fintech and financial services companies. We partner with top trading platforms and cryptocurrency exchanges, providing consulting, risk analytics, and technology solutions that power institutional trading desks across the globe. With a global team of over 2,000 professionals, Hytech has established a strong presence worldwide, with offices in Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, Philippines, Thailand, Morocco, Cyprus, and more. **About the Role** As an Operations Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving the efficiency, scalability, and excellence of Hytech’s operational teams, aligning closely with our global mission to deliver top-tier digital transformation solutions to fintech and financial services clients. You will lead a team of operational professionals, oversee end-to-end operational workflows, and collaborate cross-functionally with sales, technology, risk, and client success teams to ensure seamless service delivery. This role requires a strategic mindset paired with hands-on operational expertise, as you will balance day-to-day team management with long-term process optimization, directly contributing to the success of our institutional trading and cryptocurrency exchange partnerships. **Key Responsibilities** * Overseeing daily team operations, managing work assignments for team members, setting quarterly and annual KPIs, and conducting comprehensive performance reviews. * Proactively coordinating and resolving issues within the team, across other company functional departments, and with third-party vendors. * Facilitating seamless communication between front-end sales and back-end support teams, ensuring smooth workflows and optimizing end-to-end operational processes. * Mastering full business workflows, providing hands-on support, training, and guidance to team members to collectively meet and exceed work objectives. * Reporting team performance, work progress, and presenting actionable solutions to team challenges to department leadership on a monthly basis. * Prioritizing business processing tasks based on client needs and real-time operational status to drive team efficiency. **Requirements** * **Professional Experience & Management Expertise** : Minimum 10 years of working experience in operations, with at least 5 years of proven management experience * **Industry Background** : Strong background from fintech or brokerage companies; candidates with experience in Taiwan's local securities industry, brokerage firms, fintech space are highly preferred. * **Language Proficiency** : Proficient in both spoken and written English and Mandarin, capable of communicating effectively in cross-functional and international settings. * **Leadership & Teamwork** : Exceptional teamwork spirit, strong leadership capabilities, excellent communication skills * **Operational & Personal Competencies** : High self-discipline, proactive learning ability, and a solution-oriented mindset with strong logical and critical thinking

new_jobs.title: Head of People and Operations

This is not a traditional HR administration role. We are looking for a senior operator who combines strong people judgment with an organizational builder mentality: someone who can attract exceptional talent, develop managers, strengthen how the organization operates, and build practical systems that improve clarity, accountability and execution. You will join a lean, highly specialized organization and have significant ownership from the beginning. **What You Will Own** **Organizational Design & Operating Effectiveness** * Assess how the organization operates and identify opportunities to improve structure, workflows and accountability. * Help design and implement an effective operating model across the organization. * Clarify roles, responsibilities, interfaces and decision-making processes. * Develop and continuously improve practical **SOPs, workflows and operating standards** . * Strengthen documentation, knowledge sharing, handovers and organizational continuity. * Improve management cadence, accountability and cross-functional follow-through. * Lead implementation of organizational changes and ensure new ways of working are adopted effectively. * Continuously simplify processes, reduce duplication and improve organizational effectiveness. **Recruiting & Talent** * Lead recruiting for senior, specialist and high-impact roles. * Source and assess candidates directly while managing external search partners where appropriate. * Build disciplined hiring processes and strong talent pipelines. * Strengthen onboarding, succession planning and talent development. * Ensure organizational structure and hiring priorities remain aligned with business needs. **People & Leadership Development** * Partner with leaders and managers on performance, feedback, development, workload and retention. * Build practical performance-management and employee-development processes. * Identify organizational and people issues early and bring thoughtful recommendations to leadership. * Strengthen management capability, including delegation, communication, accountability and people development. * Support leadership in addressing capability gaps, team effectiveness and organizational needs. **Operations & Cross-Functional Execution** * Strengthen ownership, coordination and follow-through across important cross-functional priorities. * Lead selected operational projects from planning through implementation. * Establish appropriate tracking, accountability and reporting mechanisms. * Coordinate effectively with internal stakeholders and external partners. * Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks before they become larger organizational issues. * Help create a more disciplined, responsive and scalable operating environment. **AI, Systems & Process Improvement** * Identify opportunities to use **AI, automation, technology and analytics** across recruiting, people management and operations. * Build or implement practical workflows that reduce manual work and improve visibility. * Introduce tools and management information that support stronger decision-making and accountability. * Apply technology thoughtfully while recognizing where human judgment remains essential. * Continuously improve systems and processes without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. **Who We Are Looking For** **We are looking for someone with:** * Approximately **10+ years of relevant experience** across People Operations, HR, organizational development, business operations or related functions. * Meaningful experience in a **technology, high-growth, multinational or sophisticated international organization** . * Demonstrated experience improving organizational structures, operating models, processes or systems. * Experience building or implementing **SOPs, workflows and cross-functional operating processes** . * Strong hands-on recruiting capability, including senior and specialist talent. * Experience partnering directly with senior leaders and managers. * Strong judgment around organizational effectiveness, performance, development and retention. * A track record of building and improving systems rather than simply administering established ones. * Comfort using **AI, automation, analytics and digital tools** to improve how work gets done. * Excellent project-management, change-management and execution skills. * Fluent Mandarin and strong professional English. * The confidence to identify issues, bring considered recommendations and challenge constructively. * A practical, low-ego and hands-on approach. * International education or substantial international work experience is strongly preferred. **The Right Person for This Role** You may be a strong fit if you have worked inside a sophisticated technology or multinational organization and now want **broader ownership, greater autonomy and closer proximity to decision-making** . You should enjoy both strategy and execution. You may be evaluating organizational structure one day, recruiting a senior leader the next, redesigning an operating process, building an SOP or using AI to eliminate unnecessary manual work. You should be comfortable entering an environment where there is an opportunity to **build, improve and professionalize** , rather than simply maintain established systems. **We are looking for someone who naturally asks:** **How should this work? Who should own it? How can we make it simpler, clearer and more effective?** And then has the ability to make the answer real. We are looking for someone who wants to **build with us** , not simply inherit an existing function. **Working Style** This role works closely with senior leadership and functional leaders across DRIVE and DRIVE Catalyst and carries significant responsibility for organizational effectiveness and execution. Success will require discretion, sound judgment, strong communication and the ability to operate independently while building trust across the organization. **Location** Taipei, Taiwan This is an in-person leadership role requiring close collaboration with the broader team.

new_jobs.jd: **Meet the Team** The Product Operations team plays a critical role in delivering Cisco’s next-generation hardware products on a scale. Working at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing, the team ensures seamless product lifecycle execution—from new product introduction to high-volume production and customer delivery. With a strong focus on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence, the team drives impact across global operations and enables successful product outcomes. **Your Impact** The Cisco Product Operations team is seeking a seasoned Product Lifecycle Program Manager (PLPM) to provide strategic leadership over global cost management and the end-to-end product lifecycle from inception to End-of-Life (EOL). This is a high-visibility, senior-level role that requires the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders—including Manufacturing, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership—to align on strategy and execution for a portfolio of complex product solutions. You will be responsible for defining and implementing the frameworks that ensure operational efficiency and market competitiveness across our global manufacturing footprint. Key Responsibilities * Strategic Cost Management & Lifecycle Oversight: Serve as the primary architect for end-to-end product lifecycle strategy, driving rigorous cost management protocols from launch through EOL to ensure sustained profitability. * Engineering Change Governance: Provide authoritative oversight for Engineering Change Management, ensuring seamless technical transitions and minimal operational disruption. * Product Quality & Financial Stewardship: Maintain stringent control over product quality benchmarks and cost structures, ensuring alignment with organizational financial targets. * Complex Problem Resolution: Lead the mitigation of critical sustaining issues, including line-stop resolutions, CAP account management, AVL optimization, and continuous manufacturing process improvement. * EOL Strategy & Orchestration: Direct the development and execution of holistic EOL strategies, partnering with integrated product teams to ensure smooth sunsetting of legacy solutions. * Enterprise Risk Management: Oversee proactive risk assessment, including multi-source technology evaluation, component-level analysis, cost variance mitigation, and comprehensive supply chain reviews throughout the lifecycle. * Field Performance & Margin Optimization: Lead strategic action planning for product field performance and spearhead initiatives to drive continuous improvement in gross margins. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related technical field. * 5-10 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain management within the high-tech sector. * Proven track record in complex Program Management and executive-level stakeholder management. * Advanced knowledge of supply chain dynamics, specifically within high-tech environments, product costing, and sophisticated margin analysis. * Comprehensive knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and sustaining product support **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Engineering or Supply Chain Management and/or MBA. * Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) processes. * Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification. * Experience using Agile methodologies and advanced MSFT tools. * Experience in the high-tech electronics industry and large-scale electronics manufacturing. * Great executive communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Global Commodity Manager, Amazon Devices Supply Chain & Sustainability
new_jobs.jd: **Description** At Amazon Devices, we are a world-class research and development hub dedicated to creating transformative consumer electronics. Since launching the pioneering Kindle in 2007, we have spent nearly two decades developing iconic products in the eReader and eNote spaces. Our commitment to innovation has expanded our portfolio to include household names such as Fire Tablets, Fire TV, Amazon Echo, Ring, and Blink. With innovation at our core, we invite you to shape the future of technology with us. What will you help us create next? Amazon Devices is looking for passionate and creative candidates to join our operations team in Taipei. Key job responsibilities * Drive end-to-end program management, overseeing the full product development lifecycle from the RFI phase to successful high-volume manufacturing (HVM) ramp-up. * Fast learner & problem solving: Quick to master complex domains, applying rigorous analytical thinking to resolve critical business bottlenecks. * Driving strategic initiatives: Spearheaded the successful execution of high-level business strategies from conception to completion. * Data interpretation: Adept at synthesizing intricate data sets into high-value, actionable recommendations that guide executive decision-making. * Communication: Articulate communicator skilled at translating technical, operational, and commercial complexities for both technical teams and cross-border executives. * Cross-functional teamwork: Thrives in fast-paced environments, collaborating seamlessly with matrixed teams while maintaining strong independent accountability. * Priority management: Proven track record of navigating shifting priorities and resource constraints to deliver key milestones ahead of schedule. A day in the life As a Sr. Global Commodity Manager, your day is a dynamic mix of display & subcomponent strategic planning, technical problem-solving, and supplier engagement. You manage technical and commercial sourcing strategy for multiple programs from pre-concept stages to mass production in collaboration with engineering, NPI operations, legal and suppliers. You’ll collaborate with engineering teams to influence design decisions while aligning with technical and business goals. Your role involves negotiating with suppliers to secure competitive pricing and favorable terms, optimizing supply chain processes to reduce lead times and costs, and resolving complex engineering or supply chain challenges. You’ll stay ahead of market trends, pricing dynamics, and technological advancements to refine sourcing strategies, ensuring Amazon remains competitive. Cross-functional leadership is key, as you partner with legal, NPI operations, and planning teams to assess future sourcing needs and develop risk mitigation plans. You’ll also lead supplier evaluations, conduct business reviews to ensure performance meets expectations, and report progress to senior leadership, demonstrating how your strategies drive the success of Amazon Devices. **Basic Qualifications** * 8+ years of related industry experience * 6+ years of high volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments experience * 8+ years of program, project or product management, or leading product implementation experience * 6+ years of data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent experience * Experience in global supply chain management, managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company * Solid working background in the display touch and supporting subcomponent industries, with the competence to cooperate with engineering team daily to carry out core work covering, for example Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Failure Analysis (FA). **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field * Experience in negotiations with global suppliers with a proven track record in cost reduction * Experience in procurement practices working with engineering, supply chain and Tier 1 OEM partners * Experience practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, or equivalent) Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. **Company** - Amazon Development Center Taiwan Limited Job ID: A10577244
